title: Lori Bica
description: Bica, fully supports staff members keeping secrets from parents regarding gender identity.
body:
# Lori Bica

# Vice President

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/bica-profile.jpg)

- Fully **[supports](https://www.wqow.com/news/meet-the-candidates-for-eau-claire-school-board-ahead-of-april-4-election/article_97b251a2-cc15-11ed-b8c5-cb0be0eb04e1.html)** staff members keeping secrets from parents regarding gender identity.
- Signed off on the **[radical equity policy](https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1718729678/ecasdus/hs8jd6u1d60a5ldew8eb/School-Board-Equity-Statement-Final-signed.pdf)** that pushes the narrative of white privilege, systemic racism, and the hiring of employees based on race.
